summary: A solid classic daily: the big capitals are gimmes, Istanbul at #1 and Paris only at #10 are good surprises, and Baku is a stretch that starts a debate. It works in Blitz too, but well-known cities under a million score nothing.
reasons: Casual run: London, Paris, Berlin, Madrid, Rome, Moscow, Istanbul, Kyiv found; lives went on Barcelona #15, Milan #23, Amsterdam, Vienna #11, Munich #19. Out of lives at 8/10, missing Saint Petersburg and Baku.
Near misses teach the 'city limits' rule well. Baku counts as Europe on this source, which some players will argue with. Paris (2,048,472) and Vienna (2,041,286) are only 7k apart.
Blitz 19 of 31: Amsterdam, Lisbon, Athens, Brussels, Dublin, Copenhagen, Oslo and Frankfurt are accepted but score 0, and Lyon, Marseille, Naples and Turin are missing from the pool entirely.
fixes: Major European cities are missing from the answer pool, so the matcher corrects them to unrelated world cities: 'lyon' -> Lynn, 'marseille' -> Bareilly; 'naples', 'turin' are not recognized; Valencia and Rotterdam are absent too. Add European cities below 1M (e.g. a second table or category of European cities over 300k) as accepted answers.
Accepted European cities without a population score 0 in Blitz: Amsterdam, Lisbon, Athens, Brussels, Dublin, Copenhagen, Oslo, Manchester, Frankfurt. Carry their city-limits population as the stat.

Junk aliases on top-10 entries: Madrid 'Immigration to Madrid', 'Madrilenian cuisine'; Paris 'Paris culture', 'Paris agglomeration'; Berlin 'Washington Place, Berlin'; Rome 'Cecchignola'; Istanbul 'Rumeli'; Moscow 'Kotly, Moscow', 'Kotly, Moscow Oblast', 'Western Moscow'; Baku 'Baku Oilfields', 'Baku Today'; Kyiv 'Kyiv vs. Kiev', 'Kiev vs. Kyiv'.
